Introduce Hollow Wretches and basic objective pressure

title: Chapter 2: The First Gate
purpose: Expand Aten Ra story
Introduce environmental mechanics
Increase tactical complexity

summary: Push from temple roads to the first active Gate; environmental light lanes and dangerous enemy timing begin.

purpose: Major escalation
Faction-specific mechanics
Positioning becomes decisive
Mission 12 major story confrontation

title: Chapter 4: War of Titans
purpose: High-level tactical combat
Multiple simultaneous threats
Difficult objectives

title: Chapter 5: The Ascension
purpose: Final escalation
Major lore revelations
Multi-phase encounters
Mission 20 faction finale
summary: Final Sun Realm escalation with revelations about the Gate watching, not merely opening.

title: Chapter 1: Oath Under Thunder
purpose: Introduce Asgardian endurance and oath pressure
Teach counterattack timing
Establish Storm-Oath Bridge as a living war record
Reveal that the Gate listens to vows
summary: Asgardian Titans cross the Storm-Oath Bridge as old vows ignite in the ironwork and the Gate begins recording courage as usable force.

title: Chapter 2: The Banner That Forgot Its King
purpose: Introduce the Forgotten Standard Bearer as campaign pressure
Show erased wars without restoring forbidden civilization names
Add enemy command buffs
Make banners tactical objectives
summary: A nameless remnant raises a war banner on the bridge and the Asgardian line must cut command knots before forgotten orders spread.

title: Chapter 3: Marble Law, Iron Oath
purpose: Bring Olympian trial law into the Asgardian arc
Preserve faction separation through contested allied objectives
Use arena-platform movement pressure
Force clean tactical execution
summary: Olympian envoys demand trial by excellence while Asgardian law demands fulfillment of sworn duty; the Creator must win without dissolving either culture.

title: Chapter 4: The Bridge Remembers Blood
purpose: Escalate to multi-front bridge defense
Reveal that Gate memory can weaponize past vows
Introduce collapse timing and rescue pressure
Make positioning decisive
summary: The Storm-Oath Bridge begins replaying every broken vow as real battlefield pressure, forcing Asgardian Titans to defend both living allies and old dead names.

title: Chapter 5: Covenant at the Thunder Gate
purpose: Final Asgardian escalation
Resolve whether vows are fuel or responsibility
Multi-phase boss pressure
Open future cross-realm covenant story
summary: At the Thunder Gate apex, Asgardian Titans swear a covenant that denies the Gate ownership of their courage and turns oath into protection rather than bait.
